translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Mavilouna Taia kala kaivalam wosila
E Guyau ilukwaigu kawala,
“Mwa, yoku tau, kuwosi mapilana kaivalam paila Taia,
mavilouna itotu olumata e igimlomapusi guguwa deli tomota matausina eisipitalaisi kawolawa. Kuluki mavilouna avaka Guyau Yaubada ilivala kawala.Taia mavilouna itotu olumata

content.text: “Taia, yoku lokukwamnomwana paila kam gigisa saina bwaina.
M tokwaliai ikaliakaimsi makawala kaitala waga kaimanabwaita,
Matausina bikauwaisi kaga metoya Koya Emoni e bivigakaisi youdila
deli kaitala kweisila metoya Lebanoni paila varia.
Matausina ikauwaisi yawa metoya Basani paila bivigakaisi veiga;
Miyana kala vau dairarugu metoya simla Saipirosi.
Kam tokuyuva matausina metoyasi oviluwesi Saidoni deli Abadi.
M toginoli matausina goli m tomota tatoum mina luguta.
M toyowaga matausina saina mina kataraki metoya Bibilosi.
matausina igimlomapusi olumoulela m guguwa bolela.

content: “Tokabilia tolesi Pesia, Lidia, Libia eiwotetilasi osi boda m tokabilia. Matausina ilasoyasi si vayoula deli kasi kulupewa osi bwala m tokabilia. Matoulesi goli iyomitalaisi kam yakaula.
Tokabilia metoya Abadi iyausaisi kalim, tokabilia metoya Gamadi iyausaisi bolem kwaiwonaku. Matausina ilasoyasi si vayoula okalim. Matoulesi goli leivigakaimsi kam gigisa bwaina.
“Yoku kulau m guguwa mapilana Sipeini kugigimwala e lokubani makwaisina tanumnumta yagasi siliba, aiyani, tini deli ledi, makwaisina kutagwalasi mapula mi guguwa kala vakaila.
Tuvaila m guguwa kulau Girisi, Tubali, deli Meseki, e baisa kugimloki makwaisina paila m ula deli guguwa eiyoudulokaisi tanumnumta barasi.
Yoku m guguwa kugimloki paila wosa nauwotetila deli wosa paila kabilia deli miuli metoya Beti Togama.
Tomotela Rodesi igimlomapusi si guguwa deli yoku. Tomota tosisula lumata isakaimsi doga deli gai mapula m guguwa.

E mina Siria igimolaisi m guguwa deli goli bidubadu kaiuwala m valu. Matausina leisakaimsi dakuna mwau mipusi yagala emerodi, karekwa kala vau dairarugu, karekwa yaginigini, deli miyasina yakakalaia, katububula kuyouduli metoya vatu deli dakuna mwau mapula yagala rubi ivigakaisi mapula m guguwa.
Yuda deli Isireli igimolaisi m guguwa metoya witi, kitorina, olibe bulamila, deli vana ituwoli ituwoli.

E mina Damasiko igimolaisi bidubadu kaiuwala m valu, e mapula eisakaimsi waini eikauwaisi metoya Eliboni e sipi unuunula eikauwaisi metoya Saari. Matausina eigimolimapwaisi m guguwa metoya tanumnumta deli vana.
E mina Dedani igimolimapwaisi m guguwa metoya wosa kasi karekwa yapupoupou.
E Arebia deli tokaraiwogala valu mapilana Kedara igimolimapwaisi m guguwa metoya minasina lam, sipi, deli gota.
E mina Siba deli mina Rama togigimwala igimolimapwaisi m guguwa metoya dakuna mwau mipusi, goula, deli vana saina simasiminigaga.
E valu mavilousina Erana, Kanea, Ideni deli togigimwala mapilana Siba, deli goli viluwesi Asuri toyo Kilimadi - komwaidona matausina igimlomapusi deli yokomi.
Matausina eisakaimsi karekwa miyasina yammatabwaila, miyasina kala vau dairarugu, miyasina yaginigini, moi kweginigini, deli goli yuwoyoula migawelu migawelu.
Mi guguwa ikedidagaisi wa waga makaisina saina kaivakaveka baisa guguwa wogala.

content.text: Avai tuta m tokuyuva bitabusiaimsi obolita
m waga kala toyowaga deli m togigimwala,
avai tuta m waga bogwa leivia.
Komwaidona matausina ivilumgagasi paila wala yoku
e iluvalovasi tubumyou iloula opwanetasi deli iuwabugwasi otubwaga.
Matausina ninasi saina mmayuyu tutala iuvalamsi.
Matausina iwosaisi mapilana si kaivalam paila yoku, kawasi.
Taia baisa tuta bogwa eitamwau obolita?
Avai tuta m guguwa bila ituwoli valu,
yoku kukwamovi boda ituwoli ituwoli avaka magisi.
e yoku bogwa lokusabwabula lokula otukutaku.
M guguwa deli komwaidona availa availa eipupaisewasi paila yoku

content: “Komwaidona availa availa eisipitalaisi kawolawa ibulukukoli paila kam mipuki. Ilagoli si gweguya ibulukukoli wala, e kokola makwaina bogwa eikamituli omigisi.
Yoku bogwa lokutamwau, e lokutamwauvagasi wala, e togigimwala komwaidona ovalu watanawa ibulukukoli, kasi kokola paila matausina bibodasi mipuki makawala yoku.”
